credentialRequirements.description: Fastly API token supplied only within the credential adapter and scoped to the intended Fastly account and services with least-privileged permissions. The token must never be returned to the proposer.

execute.description:
Run JavaScript in a sandbox with the Fastly API client pre-authenticated.

If you already know the method, call it directly. Otherwise, use `search` first and copy its `usage` snippet.

You MUST use `return` to produce output. API methods return values directly (arrays, objects), not wrapped in `.result`. Every Fastly.*Api class is pre-instantiated as a camelCase global: `serviceApi`, `purgeApi`, `backendApi`, etc.

Example: `return await serviceApi.listServices();`

code.description: JavaScript code to execute. `Fastly` is available globally. Auth is pre-configured. Use `return` to get results.
